limits: Alternate compositions of named entries only. No elements package or workspace source aliases.
Native picker transport is Playwright setInputFiles; drop payload delivery is synthetic. OS dialogs, physical drag and drop, SSR and hydration remain separate.

runtime.policy: Locally resolved browser installations and executable bytes; no inference from package version alone.

earlierAttempt.boundary: Run01 sandbox loopback admission; run02 slotted label textContent assertion; run03 fixture text-input overflow in Firefox; run04 WebKit all-control keyboard modifier. Full72-case final run passes. Earlier raw evidence retained.

limitations: Six entries have named scenario qualification, not every export or method.
Both authored form child kinds and both file/form style deliveries are covered. Other progress disclosure variants and data normalization remain separate.
SSR and hydration are not implied.
File chooser selection uses setInputFiles; drop payloads are synthetic. OS chooser UI and physical drag/drop remain unverified.
Physical IME, native AT speech, retail Safari/OS/device conditions and separate-owner acceptance remain open.
The other70 of110 public inventory entries remain pending. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun is retired, never passed.
